text:
emma_cs: FYI customer reports CI started failing after rotating their service key with the CLI yesterday. Jobs hit 403 on embeddings and generation endpoints. Logs attached below.

jessica_acme: CI job `acme-ci-build-81` failing. curl to /v1/embeddings returns 403: {"error":"missing scope: embeddings"}. Similarly /v1/generate -> 403 missing inference. We rotated key with rdx-cli and specified scopes: inference,embeddings,rerank.

jessica_acme: CLI output after rotate: `Created key id: key_...-a1b2c3 scopes: inference,embed,reranker` — note the scopes look renamed on creation.

kevin_support: Thanks. Can you paste the key id (last 6 chars) and one failing request's x-request-id from response headers?

jessica_acme: key id ends with -a1b2c3. Example failing request id: req_20260315_9f3b.

anil_se: I pulled provisioning logs for key_a1b2c3. The provisioner is applying a legacy alias map: 
`embeddings -> embed`, `rerank -> reranker`. Our authorization layer validates against canonical names `embeddings` and `rerank`, so keys created with aliasing end up missing the canonical scopes and get 403s. This looks specific to rdx-cli v1.3.2 which included the aliasing logic.

kevin_support: Workaround for now: create a new key via Console (Dashboard -> API keys) which sets canonical scopes correctly, or PATCH the key scopes directly: 

```
PATCH /v1/keys/key_...-a1b2c3
Content-Type: application/json

{
  \"scopes\": [\"inference\", \"embeddings\", \"rerank\"]
}
```

This will normalize the scopes and restore access.

emma_cs: Jessica — can you confirm `rdx --version` on the machine that rotated the key?

jessica_acme: rdx-cli v1.3.2 (we rolled out that version across our infra).

anil_se: Confirmed. Repro steps: 
1) Install rdx-cli v1.3.2 
2) `rdx keys rotate --service acme-ci --scopes inference,embeddings,rerank` 
3) Provisioner log shows alias translation and key metadata saved with `embed` and `reranker` fields. 
4) Requests against /v1/embeddings are rejected with missing scope error.

luis_support: I filed ENG-4521 with eng-provisioner team, included repro, logs, and failing request ids. Assigned to @anil_se to triage. Temporary mitigation: disable aliasing in the canary provisioner and advise affected customers to recreate keys via Console.

jessica_acme: Created a console key and pointed CI at it — build passed. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: deploy-bot: ENG-4521 patch merged to main and scheduled for rollout at 2026-03-16 02:00 UTC. Release: rdx-provisioner@20260316-0845.

anil_se: Closing the loop here: the fix ensures CLI-provided scopes are stored using canonical names; we'll run a migration to update existing keys created by v1.3.2 to add the correct canonical scopes. If you see any other keys affected, ping this thread and we'll prioritize.

kevin_support: Marking customer case resolved on our side. Follow-up: reach out if they hit anything else.
